history.summary: The Godhra Trimandir is a non-sectarian temple of the Dada Bhagwan (Akram Vignan) movement, located 4.5 km from Godhra near Bhamaiya village, opposite the FCI godown on National Highway 59. CSV town 'Godhra' corrected to Bhamaiya. Like other Trimandirs, it houses idols of Jainism, Shaivism and Vaishnavism on one platform with equal reverence; a 151-inch marble idol of Lord Shri Simandhar Swami sits at the centre. The complex covers 22,569 sq ft with a 15,286 sq ft satsang hall, plus a bookstall, vegetarian dining hall and 'Stop N Stay' guest accommodation. Note: CSV seq 1471 'Trimurti Temple, Bhamaiya' is a POSSIBLE DUPLICATE of this site.

name: Godhra Trimandir
town_description: Bhamaiya is a small village on the outskirts of Godhra city in Panchmahal district, Gujarat, on National Highway 59 toward Ahmedabad. It lies about 4-5 km from Godhra town and hosts roadside institutions including the FCI godown opposite which the Godhra Trimandir stands. It is essentially a peri-urban settlement serving Godhra's highway corridor.
tradition: Non-sectarian (Dada Bhagwan / Akram Vignan) - Jain, Shaiva and Vaishnava shrines on one platform; not exclusively Hindu

travel.airport: Vadodara Airport, about 70 km away (verify); Ahmedabad about 125-135 km
travel.railway: Godhra Junction railway station, about 4-6 km away (verify)
travel.road: On National Highway 59 near Bhamaiya village, 4.5 km from Godhra city, opposite the FCI godown
